svg.title: The first guess before attention: every position rises through the 18 decoder layers in its own column, the reach toward the newline is cut by the stand-in attention, and only the newline's own vector reaches lm_head

g.text: the whole model runs, but every position goes through it alone
self_attn is a stand-in, no road crosses
only the row after the newline is read
the vector at the newline is computed from the newline alone,
so any photo and any question would give this same guess
the answer has to wait for attention
